blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Over eight million Manila Electric Co. (Meralco) customers will face higher electricity bills this month, as the company raised rates by P0.4895 per kilowatt-hour (kWh) due to higher generation charges. The power utility giant said the overall rate for a typical household would climb to P15.5510 from P15.0615 per kWh in October. READ: Luzon spot power rates surged 51% This means that households consuming 200 kWh would pay an additional P98 in their monthly bill this November. This marks the second straight month of hikes.
